opportunities.name: Viator destination and date tour search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for tours in a destination on a given date, then sort or filter the results (traveler rating, price, likely to sell out).
steps: Type destination in 'Where to?' and pick the suggestion
Open the date picker and click the target date
Optionally open the category filter (e.g. Likely To Sell Out)
Open the Sort dropdown and choose the sort option
